statement: RunPod's pricing page, last updated July 17, 2026, lists H100 SXM at $2.69/hr on Community Cloud and $2.99/hr on Secure Cloud, with H100 PCIe from $1.99/hr.
why: A dated rental card from a lower-cost provider shows the bottom of the rentable Hopper market, but the page states no prior price to compare against.

impact.mechanism: Per-GPU hourly list rates mark the observable clearing price for rented Hopper capacity at the discount tier of the market.

evidence.excerpt: H100 SXM (80GB VRAM, 125GB RAM, 20 vCPUs) - Community Cloud $2.69/hr, Secure Cloud $2.99/hr.

confidence.basis: Vendor pricing page carrying its own 'Last Updated: July 17, 2026' stamp; secondary source and a single provider.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 5.89 -> 2.99 (tol 1%); sources: RunPod (runpod.io)
